page.overview:
Who is Keizo?

Keizo was a middle-aged man with a muscular body, fair skin tone, and unshaven stubble. He kept a shoulder length black hair, which was tied, while having thin strands over his forehead. His eyes were usually closed, and his eyebrows appears to be quite bushy.

Keizo wore a Jiu-Jitsu gi uniform that consisted of a top and a pair of pants that is tied together with a dan black belt with the kanji for his fighting style |Soryū}} at the back.

Keizo was a kind and cheerful person who did his best to protect others with his abilities, and he was optimistic and empathic enough to assign Hakuji, a former convict, to take care of his daughter, teaching him his Soryu Style of martial arts and ultimately welcoming him into his family by allowing him to marry Koyuki and be the next head of his dojo. His memory and instructions impacted Hakuji enough even after his transformation as a demon and the loss of his memories, especially after meeting Tanjiro Kamado, who shared his same beliefs and benevolence.

One day, Keizo saved a man from bandits, who gave him the land his dojo was on as a gift. He was married and had a daughter, Koyuki. When a nearby kenjutsu dojo wanted his land for their own and were unable to cease it, they resorted to harassing potential students of the dojo, leaving Keizo with no one to teach. As such, he took on handyman jobs to make amends and had to leave Koyuki's care to his wife, who was extremely ill. Eventually the stress of Koyuki's needs and the fear of seeing her child die young led his wife to drown herself. After that, he did his best to balance making money and caring for Koyuki, even though he did not believe she would live long either.
